title: Compatible etale local representatives of an fpqc section datum
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], {g_i:T_i → S} an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and F a sheaf of sets on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Let s_i be global sections of g_i^{-1}F whose two inverse images on T_i ×_S T_j agree under the unit-compatible composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]. There is a covering sieve R on the identity etale object S and a compatible family x assigning to every arrow f:V → S in R a section x_f in F(V), such that for every i and every f in R the adjunction-unit image g_i^*x_f on V ×_S T_i equals the restriction of s_i along the structure morphism V ×_S T_i → T_i [def-pc-fibre-product]. Compatibility means that for arrows a:Z → V and b:Z → V′ with a f = b f′ the restrictions of x_f and x_f′ to Z are equal. This statement constructs a covering family of local sections, not a global section.

source.place: Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof: agreement opens, local representatives, and the covering W_i before gluing; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09XN

proof.text: For every etale V over S and t in F(V), form the largest agreement open between its unit image and the restriction of s_i on each T_i times_S V. The composition-unit equations and the prescribed overlap compatibility show that these opens have equal inverse images on all double overlaps. Use the canonical symmetry and associativity isomorphisms of fibre products to put these overlaps in the form required by etale fpqc open descent.

Descend the compatible opens to W in V by etale fpqc open descent. Restrict t to W. On the entire base change T_i times_S W, the universal property of the agreement open gives equality with the restriction of s_i; unit naturality identifies this with the matching equation in the statement.

Represent each s_i locally on T_i by a section t_ia of an etale V_ia over S, using the inverse-image section description. Apply the previous two steps to these t_ia. Compatibility shows that each representative test scheme factors through the corresponding descended W_ia: its inverse image is contained in each agreement open after fpqc base change, and joint surjectivity detects this inclusion. The test schemes cover the T_i, which jointly cover S, so the W_ia are jointly surjective and hence an etale cover of S. Choose a subfamily indexed by the points of S to meet the small covering convention. The empty base is covered by the empty family.

On any common etale test object Z, two representatives have the same unit image after every T_i times_S Z, since both match s_i. The agreement-open universal property and joint surjectivity of the base-changed fpqc covering make their largest agreement open all of Z. Test this property on the identity of Z; the inverse-image restriction theorem for etale morphisms identifies the equality with equality of the original sections. Thus the representatives are compatible.

Take R to be the sieve generated by the W_ia. Define x on an arrow factoring through W_ia by restriction of its section. Compatibility from the preceding step makes this independent of the factorization, proves x.Compatible, and by unit naturality preserves the matching equation on every arrow of R. This constructs only a local family, without invoking a global amalgamation.
